deep_observation: The translation says each target can have only one effect removed per turn (每个生物每回合只能被除去一项效果). The source says one physical AND one magical effect. In the pinned source (tome game/modules/tome/data/talents/chronomancy/matter.lua@624a6732, Disintegration doStrip around L271-296), physical and magical are tracked in separate tables, p.physical[target] and p.magical[target]. They are only reset in callbackOnActBase, so a target can lose up to two effects per turn. The translation also drops the mapping implied by '(respectively)': physical damage removes physical effects, temporal damage removes magical ones (what = type == "PHYSICAL" and "physical" or "magical"). It drops the qualifiers 'temporary' and 'While active' as well, which misrepresents the mechanic.
source:

deep_observation: The talent name 'Unstoppable Nature' is translated as 自然世界, which means 'the natural world'. It drops the core meaning of 'Unstoppable' completely. The talent (oozing-blades.lua@624a6732 L125-) is a sustained buff that grants nature resistance penetration and a chance to trigger free spits, and 自然世界 matches neither the English name nor the mechanic. The frozen input has no terminology entry for this name, so it is unclear whether this is an established name; a check of the talent-name entry's status is needed.
surface_observation: “Unstoppable”意为势不可挡，译文“自然世界”遗漏了这一含义。
“Reflex Defense”表示反射性的防御，译文“闪避神经”将“Defense”译成了“神经”。

source: Way into the heart of the gloom

deep_observation: 'THE LONGER YOU WAIT, THE MORE LIKELY IT IS THAT YOU'LL RETURN TO A SMOKING CRATER AND ONE TRULY IRATE HALFLING' means the longer the player waits before coming back, the more likely they will return to find a smoking crater (the alchemist blew himself up) and a truly irate halfling. The translation renders it as 你在这儿待的时间太长 ('you have stayed here too long'), which turns 'waiting before returning' into 'staying here', and it merges the crater and the halfling into 冒着黑烟怒不可遏的半身人, dropping the smoking crater. The causal meaning of the line is distorted (alchemist-hermit.lua@624a6732 L366-367).
source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*Disaster fails to occur. The halfling finally returns and hands you a small vial of sooty glass.*#WHITE#
ENJOY, AND COME BACK ANY TIME IF YOU'RE INTERESTED IN SIMILAR WORK. I HAVEN'T WON YET. THE LONGER YOU WAIT, THE MORE LIKELY IT IS THAT YOU'LL RETURN TO A SMOKING CRATER AND ONE TRULY IRATE HALFLING.
surface_observation: 原文称等待越久，回来时越可能见到冒烟的弹坑和愤怒的半身人；译文改成在此停留太久，并把冒黑烟误写成半身人的状态。
target:

喝吧！你要是喜欢这份工作的话随时可以回来找我。我还没赢呢！最好快点，你在这儿待的时间太长，下次迎接你的可就是一个冒着黑烟怒不可遏的半身人了。
